answer: Put identities in shared-fate groups: if one member is exposed as a sybil, the whole group loses standing — a single crack in basalt spreads through the stone. A farm's puppets must cluster together, so one detection wipes them all, or infiltrate honest groups that vet strangers hard before sharing fate. The signal is correlation itself: grouping choices are public on-ledger, so puppets spread across many groups leave a visible vine of links, and careful vetting by real peers, not stake, does the work.
